pages.text: [#](53341a)The world you walk in is not the only world that exists.[#]()
pages.title: The Spirit World

pages.text: [#](53341a)The Spirit World lies beside it, separated by a boundary that thins around places of power and at the edges of sleep.[#]()
[#](53341a)To enter, drink a Brew of Sleeping near an altar, or eat an Apple of Sleeping. You will leave your body behind.[#]()
[#](53341a)It will wait for you — try to come back before something finds it.[#]()
[#](53341a)Carries you across, leaving your inventory behind. Only the Icy Needle and a few other items transfer with you.[#]()
pages.title: Brew of Sleeping

pages.text: [#](53341a)Brings you back at once, used up. Dying also returns you, less comfortably. In emergencies: **/witchery exit**.[#]()
pages.title: Icy Needle

pages.text: [#](53341a)Brew it from **Purified Milk**, a **Cookie**, **Brew of Love**, **Whiff of Magic**, an **Icy Needle**, and an **Artichoke** — three bottles per working.[#]()
pages.title: Kettle: Brew of Sleeping
